mapper.insert: INSERT INTO running_records ( member_id, record_date, distance_km, duration_seconds, pace_seconds_per_km, memo ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{recordDate}, #{distanceKm}, #{durationSeconds}, #{paceSecondsPerKm}, #{memo} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM running_records WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY record_date DESC, id DESC

SELECT
FROM running_records WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
